claims.statement: Repository Rust validation is defined by Makefile.toml; signed application staging has a separate executable bundle contract check.

The native fork socket fixture verifies ordinary exclusive/inclusive prefixes and empty attached-child visible history, exact source preservation, distinct branch identities, idempotent readback and canonical draft handback without a model request during creation or recovery.
Selected working directories must remain under the operating-system account home verified through filesystem identities; an environment HOME override alone does not satisfy that boundary.
The isolated native read-state fixture checks explicit marks, stale-revision refusal, cold persistence, ephemeral unavailability and metadata reads without acknowledgment or extra inference.
The isolated prediction fixture checks inherited context and tool catalog, cancellation before inference, temporary cleanup, absence from durable history and unchanged parent metadata.

The native launch fixture verifies admitted Code Mode arguments, child context defaults, Agent message wakeups and fork-prefix preservation while retaining boolean and table multi-agent settings; description-first is accepted as a removed native feature.

The terminal projection retains native status and bounded error details; capacity retry requires exact failed-turn readback with serverOverloaded, and existing tests cover Other errors plus public failure size and privacy limits.

External context is sent as function_call_output through thread/inject_items; the lost-injection and lost-follow-up response test confirms that recovery retains an unknown outcome without replaying either request.
The synthetic local terminal-error and external-context tests are a separate evidence layer from qualification of the selected source runtime and from installed-application acceptance.
The source extraction regression checks that re-extraction removes obsolete files, restores archive content, and refreshes file timestamps beyond a simulated cached-build time.

Component tests separate official Release download and offline repair from fixed-commit development import, damaged-cache recovery, wrong-commit refusal and previous-selection preservation; both use isolated stores without installing the app.
The signed stage test excludes bundled Codex executables and schemas, checks Sparkle and the runtime requirement, and verifies that a missing official Release pin cannot replace a valid staged app.

Agent usage keeps cumulative spending and native last-request context separate; native usage and prediction qualification must test these distinct boundaries, while the local prediction inheritance fixture does not cover every native compaction threshold.

Shared context-default regressions check source and file-version fences, explicit off values, async threshold-table preservation, saved user values versus project overrides, and one save followed by readback after an uncertain result.

The named-native context configuration fixture is ignored by default, requires DECODEX_TEST_CODEX_BINARY, uses production launch arguments with a temporary home, and checks both boolean and async-table preferences without proving installed-app or real-provider acceptance.
The compatibility delegation regression distinguishes direct user input from tool-authority work_instruction outputs requesting retention, without selecting scheduled wakes or capacity retries.

The opt-in installed_native_discards_partial_compaction_output_after_restart fixture runs an explicitly selected CLI with a loopback provider and temporary home, then checks that a cold-resume compaction retry retains original assistant evidence and excludes a failed partial summary.

Current qualification separates source dev-small helpers, which Nextest can select through CARGO_BIN_EXE replacement, from exact signed CLI behavior in the Decodex native cohort and standalone probes. The direct signed helper session bypasses that replacement; installed acceptance and historical private launchers retain their own limits.

Conditional remote-credential snapshot cases remain unqualified after host DNS failures. Current retained stdio consumers do not provision remote executors; preserved failure evidence reopens qualification only for a concrete retained consumer or required retained-fix proof.

The retained coordination index links historical bounded real-model question-routing, completion and Busy-recovery evaluations; current synthetic child-approval and local regression qualification remains separate from real-model judgment and installed-app acceptance.
The retained sampling qualification separates presentation closure, exact native request cancellation, acknowledgement races and installed-app acceptance.

The settings probe verifies selected service-tier and reasoning-summary cold recovery with two inference requests per history mode, unchanged checkpoint behavior, and acknowledged permission recovery despite stale context through fork and cold resume with one inference request in each history mode.

The reusable log-storage probe checks default and configured diagnostic database paths, separation from environment-selected state storage, and unauthenticated login status when diagnostic storage is unavailable; it does not qualify managed storage precedence, NFS or data migration.

Exact-artifact probes retain terminal modelNotFound without retries, distinct policyCapacityUnavailable with bounded native HTTP retry, large explicit model catalogs and stable missing-provider item identity. Error classifications persist through live, stored and cold reads without a Decodex capacity retry.

Project Work qualification records exact CLI/helper/schema identities and local/native cohorts; original ICE failures remain separate from later passing full-suite and repeated checks, recovered lock and firewall history, and the limits of controlled lock experiments and physical audio.

Native Project/global Guardian/private records are exercised through the retained production bridge; follow-up qualification adds retained Project membership and nested V1/V2 Work attribution under actual native model/configuration selection, preserving V2 direct-only defaults.
The native private-record observer preserves reviewer and parent identity, excludes raw reasoning, retains no guessed action Review link and cannot complete Work or alter parent history.
Work qualification tests enforce four-Work Result separation, current requirements, scoped reads before limits and digest-bound selected evidence without installed-app or live-model acceptance.

Native Work recovery preserves direct and visible-input proof and can recover a prepared encrypted task name through native parent metadata, root turn and unique activity without replay; it does not prove encrypted text, and unnamed or ambiguous assignments remain Unknown.

The follow-up separately records seven passed native tests, 189 database tests, schema57/90-table integrity and a final 2921-pass workspace run with 1157 skipped and no LEAK, preserving its first three failures and unexplained resume-test LEAK.

The clean committed source-bundle acceptance used gpt-6-astra at Medium in two Projects with four completed Works, same-request requirement repair, twelve matching artifact Result hashes and persistent native identities; five private review outputs include an actual post-restart automatic-review probe.

The final lifecycle qualification passed 2924 workspace tests with 1159 skipped and no LEAK, nine selected native tests with no unmatched selector and strict lint for 13 packages; its earlier two leaky passes and clean isolated controls remain separate evidence.

Official Codex Project presentation and controlled lock-screen behavior remain unqualified; installed development, synthetic online voice and user-observed playback have separate bounded evidence, while installed-UI device-ADM and broad audio quality remain unmeasured.

The control follow-up verifies actual UI Pause/Resume, persistence and rejection of native preparation and valid-evidence completion while held, then owner completion after release; the four original Works and Results remain unchanged.

The real Full Access probe observes an outside-Project write denied under Workspace, allowed before and after a Full Access restart, and denied again after Workspace restoration; the global Guardian preference remains separate.

Three native permission tests and one database hold test pass after explicit binary setup and global-reviewer fixture alignment, with strict lint and format checks; the earlier failure receipts and unrepeated full-suite scope remain explicit.

Old venue and lodging helpers have verified native parentage and matching encrypted call/input payloads, but returned-message contribution labels do not prove the prepared plaintext and no strong Work binding is written.

The unchanged-source hardware follow-up passes three existing physical USB capture and local PCM lifecycle tests plus two separate synthetic media tests, with no retries, saved microphone audio, uploads or system route changes. Virtual output does not qualify audible physical-speaker behavior.

The complete temporary acceptance fixture, test copies, authentication copies and exact-owned helpers were removed after private accepted database and source evidence preservation; user-installed applications and unrelated processes were unchanged.

The installed development qualification binds a clean signed application to a two-Project/four-Work real-provider scenario, repaired independent-Agent input and approval ownership, restart and permission controls, measured user-data preservation and exact-owned cleanup; its 1025-pass UI package retains unexplained complete-run cleanup markers separately from three clean isolated controls and twelve native regressions.

Two synthetic online tests pass with final dictation, unchanged Agent history, decoded live speech and positively ended native calls in fresh product and native homes; separate playback was audible but quiet, and the retained fixture, hashes and cleanup receipts do not extend that result to real-microphone UI or general audio quality.

The three selected read-only views have separate source/schema, exact-artifact memory and usage, local collaboration/usage and four-test UI proof in selected_read_views. Qualification passed 2998 workspace, two native, four UI and 28 Python tests plus strict lint, format and schema59 gate; full vstyle failed with 16517 findings. No installed interaction, complete Work cost, release, runtime baseline, review cursor or schedule change is claimed.

Persistent attached-branch qualification against native source 970111f6cb62cc02fe36a82ea7d71b37a2889c97 records five executed exact-artifact native tests, 57 focused backend tests, six UI tests and 3006 workspace passes with one LEAK and a clean affected repeat. Artifact/helper/schema hashes, exact identities, source limits, synthetic provider and absence of installed desktop acceptance remain separate; two upstream test functions with five cases were read but not executed.
Observed timing qualification records 1891 passed headless tests and two selected presentation tests; it does not establish installed-app interaction or live-provider timing.

The selected CLI schema exposes a nullable turn duration but no full critical-path categories; source research on experimental analytics used modified source and synthetic services rather than a supported client subscription.

Five historical synthetic MCP socket cases at upstream abf4bb91 produced three passes and two thread-start compatibility failures. This evidence does not qualify a sharing default in the current runtime; no sharing launch flag was added and the native user setting was not inspected.

The locked HTTPS graph selects rustls 0.23.46, rustls-webpki 0.103.16 and webpki-root-certs 1.0.11; account refresh and component downloads use reqwest clients and the selected dependencies include certificate-distrust updates.

The original macOS arm64 TLS qualification records passing baseline and candidate workspace checks and 36 account/component tests each, 1891 candidate headless tests, lint for 11 packages, and one executed upstream distrusted-SPKI test; it does not qualify live HTTPS, other platforms, installation or release.

Four candidate synthetic voice tests passed after firewall admission; an earlier subsequent stress run had 39 passes and one unexplained post-unmute assertion failure, while a separate interleaved comparison passed 80 executions across the prior and candidate test executables. Physical audio and installed-app behavior remain unqualified.

The default macOS WebRTC build selects webrtc-sys-build 0.3.21 and release webrtc-a545de4, verifies the pinned official ZIP digest and local/central header consistency before extraction or cache replacement, and keeps explicit custom directories separate.

The original macOS arm64 guard qualification passed the full workspace check, strict lint for 13 packages, six guard tests, four synthetic voice tests and 40 repeated voice executions; both original official macOS archives passed digest and strict-header validation, while eleven upstream ZIP tests are retained from the preceding delivery.

The guard compares cached files with the verified ZIP, stages repairs and preserves owner access; its qualification does not establish arbitrary malformed-archive safety, x64 native execution, physical audio, live-provider, installed-app or release acceptance.
The 40-pass WebRTC stress qualification was established from each iteration and the final summary because cargo-nextest 0.9.143 can return zero after an earlier failed iteration.
The reusable exact-artifact startup fixture checks prompt CLI exit with either a missing .env or a directory at .env; this does not establish provider, account or installed-app acceptance.

The native voice development-signing qualification preserves the original pre-consent ICE timeout and records 16 successful post-consent executions of four real WebRTC tests. Original and rebuilt code hashes differ while the designated requirement matches, with known allow decisions and no queued or prompt events in both measured windows; signer, path, host and historical audio-assertion limits remain explicit.

Current targets and cohort counts stay in the linked review and qualification records. Daily execution selects affected Decodex consumers; unconsumed upstream failures remain diagnostic limits without advancing review or becoming a local repair requirement.

The retained public certificate probe checks the selected exact WebRTC ZIP, retired AAA root absence and retained control DER bytes in its static library; optional baseline verification uses a recorded old-library digest, and these checks do not execute TURN/TLS or qualify the selected Codex CLI or installed application.
Current permission defaults apply to new conversations, native children inherit their parent settings, and global Guardian controls optional review records without overriding conversation reviewers.

The current desktop feedback cohort at cfa54c6f executed 25 distinct Decodex tests, 19 GPUI and six runtime projections, with no unmatched selector. Four upstream test functions were read and none executed. An original-dispatcher comparison fails the reconnect wait assertion; the repair passes with original-key, pending-request and later-edit checks.

The 25 assertions passed with one nextest process-cleanup marker in a pure layout-state case; its isolated repeat passed cleanly and the delay cause remains unmeasured. Affected repository Clippy, nightly format, 14 architecture/gate tests and the Swift build passed. Native component/schema identities are reused unchanged, with no runtime migration, upstream suite, provider, installed-app, physical-display or packaged-menu-bar acceptance.

The Codex startup-configuration diagnostic control and helper are retired. Its previous executions remain historical evidence and impose no current regression requirement. Current validation covers Decodex product/integration behavior without advancing source review or activating the paused automation.

The history_resource_cost qualification records 19 distinct qualified Rust checks, two Menu Bar tests, 14 architecture/gate checks and four upstream test bodies read without execution. Its exact selected-artifact fixture checks nearby native history and registered resource owners using two synthetic turns without additional lookup inference; runtime migration, installed app, live billing and historical upload discovery remain unqualified. Earlier unchanged checks retain their recorded limits; the added current-destination regression fails before repair and passes afterward.

Conversation-list branching was delivered through PR #2559 at source 5f2fbffac0a5590affd76dcdc3bc73ff83b3cefe. Eight focused GPUI tests executed with zero unmatched selectors, strict affected Clippy and formatting passed. The batch reuses the retained native fork contract without a runtime migration or fresh upstream/native artifact execution; upstream active-turn rejection was only partially inspected and physical, installed-app and live-provider acceptance remain unmeasured.
